recommended.variant: Native input with persistent visible label, visible hint and error linked through aria-describedby, aria-invalid while invalid, and an explicit post-submit focus path. aria-errormessage is additive only where its target pair passes.

entries.behavior: HTML supplies native text input and label semantics; WAI-ARIA supplies invalid and description relationships. Neither specification guarantees dynamic error announcement.
entries.decision: Use native input and label with describedby/invalid and deterministic error discovery; never rely on errormessage alone.

entries.behavior: The published test fails to convey the pertinent aria-errormessage on a text input with aria-invalid=true in both browse and focus commands; without another association the error is unavailable.
entries.decision: Always retain aria-describedby; aria-errormessage-only is blocked for this observed pair.

entries.behavior: The published pertinent-error test passes on JAWS/Chrome; the same JAWS version also passes on Edge. Chrome/Edge support does not transfer to Firefox.
entries.decision: Additive aria-errormessage is permitted for this tested pair while aria-describedby remains the baseline.

entries.behavior: The published pertinent-error test fails on JAWS/Firefox in both reading and focus commands, unlike the Chrome/Edge passes.
entries.decision: Do not enable aria-errormessage as a relied-on announcement path for this pair; retain describedby.

entries.behavior: The 2025-12-24 pertinent-error result passes and speaks the example error text on swipe navigation.
entries.decision: Additive aria-errormessage is permitted for this measured pair; describedby remains the portable baseline.

entries.behavior: The 2025-12-24 pertinent-error result fails in both VO+Right and Tab commands; invalid data is spoken but the example error text is omitted.
entries.decision: Do not rely on aria-errormessage for current macOS; use describedby and verify the actual implementation in the real lane.

entries.behavior: The 2025-12-24 pertinent-error result passes on swipe and speaks the example error text; the real implementation still requires testing.
entries.decision: Additive aria-errormessage is allowed for this measured pair, with describedby retained and real-iOS verification pending.
